newsitem.title: GERMANY: Viag wants to buy EVS/Badenwerk stake - report.
newsitem.headline: Viag wants to buy EVS/Badenwerk stake - report.

text.p: German diversified industrial group Viag AG wants to buy a stake in the joint energy companies of Energieversorgung Schwaben AG (EVS) and Badenwerk AG, a newspaper report said on Friday.

The Stuttgarter Zeitung said Viag Chief Executive Georg Obermeier had expressed interest in buying the 30 percent share in EVS/Badenwerk owned by the state of Baden Wuerttemberg, with an estimated value of over 2.5 billion marks ($1.6 billion).
But the newspaper reported Obermeier as saying there had been no talks yet about the possible deal.
Viag was not immediately available for comment on the report.
The newspaper reported Obermeier as saying that energy along with telecommunications would remain the centre of growth and investment at the company.

It said the purchase would help towards Viag energy subsidiary Bayernwerk's goal of becoming the third biggest electricity company in Germany, building a counterweight to the other energy giants RWE and Veba.
It also said that with the merger at EVS and Badenwerk, the state of Baden-Wuerttemberg had already planned to sell its share to a private investor.
This summer EVS and Badenwerk announced their plans to merge with effect from the beginning of 1997, creating the fourth biggest German energy concern.
